# Upstream agent fixture

`agent.sh` is the Linux agent from
[Forward-Future/device-monitor](https://github.com/Forward-Future/device-monitor) at commit
`c3a4c41`, copied byte for byte (SHA-256
`7e4a2d66518939e660055e5790dbef9d92ab134ef3a0fad24f306824b93c292d`, checked by
`TestUpstreamAgentReports`). Do not edit it: the test proves that an unmodified upstream agent
reports to this hub.
